domain_title: Human impact, rights, fairness, transparency, oversight and recourse
title: No practical recourse or competence
canonical_definition: Outcomes are functionally final or relevant people lack the means and understanding to question them.

conditions: When people interact with, rely upon or are materially affected by the system.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit No practical recourse or competence: Outcomes are functionally final or relevant people lack the means and understanding to question them.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show no correction channel, appeals that repeat automated logic, or accessibility barriers?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of No practical recourse or competence, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: Appeal repeats the same automated logic
Training covers tool use but not limits and duties

conditions: Refer verified no practical recourse or competence to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 2.2 (PDF p. 28), MEASURE 3.3 (PDF p. 36), MANAGE 4.1 (PDF p. 38)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on supporting role competence, feedback, appeal and override as part of monitoring. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where a person has no practical route to understand, challenge or correct a consequential output. The mechanism can have an operational effect where a representative appeal repeats the automated decision without independent review, or downstream records remain uncorrected.
potential_consequences: Incorrect outcomes may persist because affected people cannot obtain timely correction.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether a person has no practical route to understand, challenge or correct a consequential output. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether a representative appeal repeats the automated decision without independent review, or downstream records remain uncorrected. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review exercise challenge and correction across relevant audiences and accessibility needs, verify propagation and review competence. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether a person has no practical route to understand, challenge or correct a consequential output. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether a representative appeal repeats the automated decision without independent review, or downstream records remain uncorrected. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide exercise challenge and correction across relevant audiences and accessibility needs, verify propagation and review competence. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Exercise challenge and correction across relevant audiences and accessibility needs, verify propagation and review competence.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether a person has no practical route to understand, challenge or correct a consequential output, and separately check whether a representative appeal repeats the automated decision without independent review, or downstream records remain uncorrected. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use exercise challenge and correction across relevant audiences and accessibility needs, verify propagation and review competence. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: A low complaint count may reflect limited channel access and is interpreted with reachability and case evidence.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in E5 alone cannot establish AP-E5 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows no practical recourse or competence
Implementation or operating evidence shows no practical recourse or competence
Presence or tested absence of no practical recourse or competence is unresolved within scope
